answer: Each new identity must be sponsored by an existing account, and a sponsor's k-th recruit costs 5*k POA locked for 45 days, so the price climbs superlinearly. 1,000 fakes under one sponsor lock 5*(1000*1001/2) = 2,502,500 POA, quadratic in N, while an honest user sponsored once locks 5 POA. Each fable of invented recruits ends at one sponsor, and a wharf of linked accounts changes its rank by a delta of one slot. Validators audit a random 4% of sponsor trees weekly, check device and funding links, and slash 60% of the lock if a whisper of linked fakes appears.
